story: Anthropic launches Claude Sheets and Whiteboards in beta, makes Claude Data generally available
source_line: Sources: Anthropic, Tom's Guide, Fone Arena

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Claude adds Whiteboards and Sheets
segments.point: Shared tools your team can use
segments.narration: Claude adds whiteboards and spreadsheets your team can share.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Whiteboards and Sheets launch in beta
segments.narration: On November tenth, Anthropic launched Whiteboards and Sheets in beta. Dashboards is now Claude Data, generally available.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Shared boards, prompt-built sheets
segments.narration: Teams brainstorm with Claude on a shared board. Sheets builds spreadsheets from prompts. Data needs a connector.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: On all paid Claude plans
segments.narration: It's on all paid plans. The catch: Sheets is still basic.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Pilot Whiteboards first
segments.narration: Our take: try Whiteboards at your next team meeting. Keep your spreadsheet tool for now.

segments.title: Want this set up for your business?
